_readme: curated_mcp.claude.example.json — Preset B curated MCP config (EXAMPLE).
Copy to an absolute operator-owned path OUTSIDE every loop tree, fill in
the placeholders, chmod 0600, and point AAS_ARL_MCP_CONFIG at the copy
(see production_formalization_env.inc.sh). Never place a filled copy
inside a loop directory: the loop tree is agent-writable and this file
decides which live tool servers the unattended agent may reach.
The LeanExplore per-server env block carries AAS_SKILL_SECRETS_FILE: an
absolute path to an owner-controlled, non-symlink 0600 env file containing
LEANEXPLORE_API_KEY=<key>. Keep that file outside every loop tree.
an env -i keep-list cannot deliver the key to the managed MCP launcher.
Do NOT replace the placeholders in the repo copy of this example.
Delete this _readme key if your MCP client rejects unknown top-level keys.
